claim_one_line: THE FILE-DRAWER LOCK'S EXEMPTION LIST IS PARTLY UNEARNED. tests/test_b837_file_drawer.py exempts twelve sealed-and-ledgered preregs from the reporting obligation under the comment 'the 12 audited as REPORTED in a successor arc's findings (B837)'. B837's FINDINGS names only FIVE of the twelve (B452, B568, B580, B634, B652). SEVEN are exempted on an audit trail that does not mention them: B473, B501, B502, B503, B506, B565, B570. Worse, for three of those the apparent supporting citation is a NUMBERING COLLISION: B521's own text states 'B493-B503 collides with this trunk's B496-B503', and the arcs it cites are the AUDIT SEAT's B501_gateB_reductions, B502_gateC_commensurator and B503_tower_timebox -- different arcs from main's B501_universe_word, B502_parity_signature and B503_external_contact. So the exemption was granted on citations to ANOTHER SEAT'S ARCS THAT HAPPEN TO SHARE NUMBERS. This is the repo's own 'cited-as-sufficient' kill form, occurring inside a governance gate whose entire purpose is to prevent it, and it is why the lock PASSES while genuine file-drawer entries sit behind it. DISPOSITIONS: B501 and B502 are GENUINE FILE-DRAWER (their only citation is a FORWARD pointer in B500, which PRECEDES them); B503 is owner-gated by its own sealed text (Send = the owner's hand only) and is owed a DISPOSITION record rather than an exemption, the pattern B913 established; B506 IS genuinely reported, by B507_beta_function which engages its content directly (the B506 emergent drift has its SOURCE here, the B506's d consistency lock), so the exemption was right and only its citation was wrong; B473, B565 and B570 are cited in successor findings but were NOT line-checked here and are recorded as UNVERIFIED_EXEMPTIONS, a named debt rather than a clean pass, because marking them verified without reading would repeat this the arc's own finding. THE CORRECTION: one comment replaced by four explicitly-labelled sets each carrying its real basis. THE LESSON AT GATE LEVEL: a gate is only as good as the provenance of its exemptions -- every allowlist entry must name the document that discharges it, and that document must actually contain the arc; an exemption whose justification cannot be grepped is a silent hole, and a hole in a governance gate is worse than the same error in an arc because it reports GREEN. ORIGIN: cc3 flagged these arcs and this the seat's FIRST check was WRONG -- it observed they sit in SEAL_LEDGER and that the lock passes, and treated that as reassurance; the lock passes because they are on an allowlist.
